task: B1 EVAL obstacle.offline -> agent join (WP-6 agent conditioning)
_evidence_class: MEASURED (ours; artifact = the jsonl + this meta)

corpus.name: B1 v7.2 EVAL split
corpus.note: B1 = the 4,719-clip v7 corpus (4,713 built after the parity gate drops 6 val40 clips); the v7.2 release splits it 4,572 TRAIN / 147 EVAL; 141 of the 147 have pixels in the built B1 epcache and are what refav1 scores on.

key.frame_index_space: RAW v2ep index i in [0, n_target) -- NO n_stack trim; identical to b1_eval_lead_block.npz's `frame`, and DIFFERENT from build_obstacle_join's post-trim `frame_idx` (i - (n_stack - 1))
key.why_renamed: the key is `frame`, not `frame_idx`, so the two index spaces cannot be silently confused

gate.statistic: max |v2ep poses[:,3] - block speeds| at the SAME (clip_id, frame)
gate.why: both are egomotion interpolated at that frame, so agreement proves the join hit the right clip AND frame; INDEPENDENT of the registration fit

reported_only.note: registration PRECISION, not key correctness -- a clip with few registration probes carries a smooth time bias while its frame index is exactly right

alignment_proof.key: (clip_id, frame) with frame = RAW v2ep index
alignment_proof.control: mis-join(+1): frame i+1 read against block frame i, on the SAME statistic as the gate

conventions.frame: per-frame EGO frame, +x fwd +y LEFT (refb_labels.ego_frame via bev_raster.ego_frame_agents)
conventions.composition: rig@sample -> world at the sample's OWN timestamp -> ego@frame
conventions.time: recovered per clip by lead_source.register_poses_to_time over the RAW pose array (grid ~0.1007 s, not 0.1)
conventions.NO_LABEL: absent (clip, frame) line -- outside the obstacle span; an EMPTY agents list IS a label (labelled clear)
conventions.occ: 0 = agent centre inside the 120 deg front-camera field, 1 = outside while the track continues; IS bev_raster.fov_mask at agent-centre granularity (P4_PREDICATE_IDENTITY), not an independent occlusion label

digest_scope.note: scope MEASURED by hashing both artifacts of b1eval_agents.jsonl.xz; the other candidate was 51551ca060d95946f8a25ad59466924a
